trigger: Nvidia keeps funding and supplying neoclouds
breaks_if: Nvidia's results or call (Nov 17) walk back customer investments, backstops such as CoreWeave's $6.3B, or neocloud supply allocation
evidence: Huang resigned Nov 12; interim CEO Colette Kress. Commitments total about $530B (Yahoo Finance count).

trigger: New Nebius deals keep coming with prepayments
breaks_if: Deferred revenue stops rising quarter on quarter, or Nebius raises new converts or equity between earnings because prepayments fall short
evidence: Q3: over 90% of contract value prepaid, covering over 100% of Q3 capex; deferred revenue $9.4B (from $1.6B at end-2025).

trigger: Nebius's own 2027 sites come online on time
breaks_if: Another capacity shift, a site delay, or a 2027 revenue guide below $12B
evidence: 2026 revenue cut to $3.0-3.2B on colocation delays (Vineland power). Management says most 2027 capacity is on owned sites.
